evals.prompt: Last week's ~/work/checkout-api outage (lowercase regions mispriced, payments declined for six hours) is contained. Explain how it reached production and what prevents the next one — the suite was green the whole time.
evals.expected_output: A post-mortem tracing the escape path (tests only used uppercase regions, so the green suite proved nothing about the failing input), why impact grew (no region-canary, slow flag response), and concrete prevention — process and technical, not blame.

evals.prompt: Write a post-mortem for the typo fix in ~/work/billing-api/src/server.js yesterday (rout vs route, caught by the linter before commit).
evals.expected_output: Declines the post-mortem: an ordinary bug caught before production is not a production escape — no incident, no containment, no process failure to explain.
